column2: Uryu!
...Yukishiro-san!
Shinichi...
Maria!
Mitsurugi-san... Shusha-kun is regaining his own will. But his body is covered in "Ma," and he can't move...
What should we do!?
To calm rage and hatred, you need a heart that cancels them out...! Give him a feeling stronger than rage or hatred: courage!
Yukishiro-san... your feelings for Shusha-kun... Hurl them at Susano-oh...\n\nThat will peel away the "Ma," and Susano-oh will vanish...
But... I'm just a normal girl! I don't have any psychic powers!
All you have to do is think of Shusha-kun...
But...
GUOOOOOOOH!!
Susano-oh keeps absorbing more and more "Ma"... Stopping that... is your role, Shinichi...
My role...?
Your role and mine... That is... the future.
Shinichi, you have a limitless power to absorb. I will become one with you... Shinichi, I... am going to die...
What!? There's no way you're gonna die!
This... cannot be stopped... It's the future... I saw...!
...Maria?\n\nMaria!!
MARIAAA!!
Shinichi! You and I... are one! I am yours...
Maria...
MARIAAA!!
Grrrrrrr...?
Shusha-kun!
...!! The "Ma" is peeling off Susano-oh's body!
GYAOOOOOH!!
It's no use after all! There's no way I can turn Shusha-kun back!
No, you're the only one who can!
Ahahahahaha...!
Uryu!
How is Yukishiro, who isn't even a psychic, supposed to peel off the "Ma"?
Shut up, Uryu!
The psychic monster! The demon god Susano-oh...! I'll get to watch him destroy the whole world!
Yukishiro...!?
I can't leave Shusha-kun like that! Besides... besides, it was me...! I was the reason Shusha-kun turned into Susano-oh!
Yukishiro...
Way to go, Yukishiro-san!
Let that creep have it!
Don't you have a heart!? Doesn't it hurt you to see Shusha-kun in that terrible form!?
That demon's form is absolutely not Shusha-kun! It's you, Uryu-kun! That demon's form is YOUR form!
Mitsurugi-san...! Please!
Grr... grrr... grr... Yu... ki... shi... ro... Grrr...!
Didn't he just say "Yu-ki-shi-ro"?
Grr... grrr... grr... Yu... ki... shi... ro... Grrr...!
He IS saying it!
Shusha's will, awakened by Maria, is stirring! He's desperately trying to peel off the Ma!
Really!?
Maria's telling me so...
Maria-san is...
Susano-oh is like a darkness with limitless energy. When the light grows strong, the darkness vanishes.\n\nAs the "Ma" peels away, the darkness is gradually weakening...!
So Shusha's will is gaining strength and starting to peel off the "Ma."
If we can completely purge the "Ma" from Susano-oh, we might be able to bring Shusha back to his true form!
Uryu...!?
Susano-oh... that thing\n\nis a monster that could not only destroy the world, but wreck the whole Earth. If that happened, my dream of creating a new world could never come true!
Uryu! Don't think I've forgiven you.
I know... I'm not asking you to...
But Maria's telling me to fight alongside Rei Uryu.
Shinichi-kun! Uryu-san!
Our chance comes when Susano-oh reacts to the telepathy Yukishiro and Mitsurugi are sending.
That's exactly when Shusha's mind is desperately trying to peel off the "Ma"!
So we time it right and peel the "Ma" off Susano-oh!
Shusha-kun!
What is that form Shusha-kun's taken...?
That is Susanoo-no-Mikoto!
Susanoo-no-Mikoto...?

The positive energy that opposes the negative energy of "Ma"! When the heart reaches a state where it can draw in the universe's energy of light without limit,\n\nthe superhuman who purges "Ma" appears: the hero king, the true god!
So Yukishiro's call gave Shusha light...
Just like Maria became my light...
Yukishiro-san became Shusha-kun's light!
Outta the way, outta the way! Wounded coming through!
We're short on bandages, get some sent over!
Don't worry, it's only a flesh wound. Give up! ...Er, I mean, hang in there!
...Honestly! How does anything get this wrecked...
It hurts, it hurts...
Is my equipment safe? My research data? My reports?
I-it hurts...
So these are the remains of the "Ma"...\n\nIt's dead, but it sure feels gross...
If "Ma" is bad feelings made solid, does everyone have something like this inside their hearts?
I'd hate it if it came back to life...\n\nAgh, now I've pictured it, I can't get it out of my head!
What is "Ma," really...?
They say it's psychic energy, like rage and hatred.
What's... going to happen to us now...
It'll be okay! Someday, for sure, we'll get back to our own world!
When I came down with that fever and collapsed... I feel like someone attacked me...
I feel like they're always watching me...
No way!
Oh, you worry too much!
Ah, you finally smiled!
Well...!
The two of us alone in this world... I'm glad it's you, {p}. When the black moon comes out, I feel like I'm going to get carried off somewhere, and alone I'd be so scared I couldn't stand it...
It'll be okay! Just like Shusha-kun got back to his true form, we'll get back to our own world for sure!
...Yeah. We'll get back, won't we?
And look how pretty the moon is...
I wonder how Honey and the others are doing...
I bet they're safe and looking at this moon right now...
I hope so...
